# FlexDays

> FlexDays is the HR super app: one simple, affordable app for leave management, timesheets, a one-tap time tracker, and company events and announcements, on iOS, Android and the web. Every company gets its first 30 days free at any size; after that, the first 10 employees are free, then $2 per employee per month. FlexDays is live: sign up free at https://portal.flexdays.app/register.

FlexDays is built for companies that want to replace spreadsheets, email chains, messaging apps and expensive legacy HR systems with one modern app. It sets up in under 5 minutes, needs no IT team, and works for companies of any size, from small teams to 500+ employees. It supports teams in any country, with public holidays and working weeks set automatically by country and location. FlexDays is built by beanvoid, a product studio based in Egypt.

## Key facts

- Product: FlexDays, the HR super app
- Status: live. Sign up free at https://portal.flexdays.app/register (web portal); the iOS and Android apps are rolling out on the App Store and Google Play
- Pricing: every company gets its first 30 days free at any size; after that, the first 10 employees are free, with no time limit and no credit card; $2 per employee per month above 10 employees (you only pay for employees over 10); no setup fees; cancel anytime; 14-day refunds
- Billing: handled securely by Paddle
- Platforms: native iOS and Android apps plus a full web portal, always in sync
- Setup: under 5 minutes with a guided 6-step checklist (company, public holidays, working days, leave types, org structure, employee import)
- Who it's for: HR teams, founders, owners and managers at companies of any size, worldwide, with a focus on Southeast Asia and the Middle East & North Africa (MENA)
- Made by: beanvoid (https://www.beanvoid.com/)
- Contact: hello@beanvoid.com (support and privacy: support@beanvoid.com)

## Features

- Leave management: employees request leave in seconds; balances for annual, sick, WFH and custom leave types update automatically; carry-over rules; part-time schedules
- Timesheets: connected directly to leave and working schedules, so there is no double entry
- Time tracker: a one-tap timer on projects and tasks, or clock in and out with breaks; every minute flows straight into the timesheet
- Projects and time reports: log time against projects and tasks, mark billable time, and see dashboard, summary, detailed, weekly and attendance reports with Excel or CSV export
- Working schedules: working days, weekends and shifts set per location
- Multi-level approvals: approval chains with one or more levels (any one approver or all of them), assigned to employees and set up by HR or Admins without IT. Without a chain, requests go to the employee's department manager
- Multi-country public holidays: applied automatically by country and location
- Bulk employee onboarding: import a whole team from an Excel file
- Leave balance import: bring existing balances over from a spreadsheet (one row per employee, one column per leave type), with a preview before anything changes
- Smart notifications: real-time push notifications for approvals, balance reminders and team updates
- Events and announcements: share company news and events with everyone, a location, a department, a team or specific people, with a push notification and a spot on the team calendar
